integrity: An analytic proof accompanies the computations; independently reproduce finite hull losses and five numerical inversions using VERIFY.py. No external independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed nondegenerate convex polygons under independent boundary-arclength sampling. The triangle inverse needs a separately known perimeter and exact population moments of the limit law; noisy finite-sample inverse stability and uniform degenerating-polygon rates are unproved. First-moment asymptotics in related boundary-polytope literature are credited; historical priority is provisional.
title: Corner-product area-loss law and two-moment reconstruction of triangles
